description: dnora is Python software for dynamically downscaling offshore wave products to a local coastal domain. Its README names NORA3 wave hindcasts, WaveWatch III forecasts and ERA5 as possible inputs, with examples using SWAN and SWASH near Norway. Users provide offshore forcing, bathymetry and model settings; outputs are local wave conditions for the selected coastline or structure. Geographic coverage follows the user-defined coastal domain. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing, and the README gives pip and Conda installation routes. A limitation is that nearshore wave results depend on bathymetry resolution, boundary conditions and the chosen numerical engine. The older v1 branch is no longer maintained, so users should follow v2 documentation. dnora can provide wave loads for ports, flood defences or coastal road simulation. The related catalogue ERA5 record is one upstream weather source, not this downscaling workflow. No wave archives or software were downloaded.
name: dnora wave-product downscaling
